summary: Frontend-only testing of CoverPreview live book cover feature on /create page. All 7 required features verified via Playwright with session cookie injection.
critical_code_review_comments: Theme color test assertion note: browser normalizes hex colors in inline styles to rgb() format (e.g. #0284c7 → rgb(2, 132, 199)). Any future test assertions should compare rgb values or use regex.
context_for_next_testing_agent: CoverPreview feature fully tested and working. Cookie injection requires page.context.add_cookies (property, not method call). Theme bg values returned as rgb() by browser, not hex.
